data.one_liner: Checkers and tools to verify accessibility and test app behavior during development.
data.what_it_does: Checks your user interface as you build it for accessibility issues like missing semantic labels, small tap areas, and image labels. It also provides a testing tools panel with toggles for text scale, localization, text direction, and color mode simulations.
use_when: You want to ensure your Flutter app is accessible from day one during development.
You need to test your app under various text scales, localizations, and platform settings.
avoid_when: You are deploying to production builds (the tools only run in debug mode).
You cannot meet the package's minimum Dart and Flutter version requirements.
strengths: Runs automatically in debug mode as you build your interface.
Includes a comprehensive testing tools panel for simulations like color blindness and screen reader modes.
weaknesses: Requires migration and specific compatibility setup if using standalone material_ui packages.
Font overflow checks are experimental and disabled by default.
data.setup_notes: Add AccessibilityTools to your app's builder property in debug mode.
